newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, pressured by scattered profit-taking after recent price rises, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower. Benchmark April was 1.4 yen weaker at 143.1 yen.
Activity was lacklustre as private investors were tending to stick to the sidelines ahead of the spot expiry next Monday.
"Prices could drift within narrow ranges this week ahead of the spot expiry. The resistance at 145 yen for benchmark April could be tough to break through," one trader said.
